core.desiredConfigStore: SQLite on persistent local filesystem; immutable in-memory runtime generations; no database reads on the user traffic path.
core.pluginLifecycle: Operator installs, starts, updates and restarts every plugin using operator-selected tooling. Core connects to registered replica endpoints and exposes no installation or process/container management API.

management.webController: Private HTTPS, client mTLS and a distinct Bearer service credential per binding; credentials never enter a browser.
management.desktop: Restricted SSH port-forward to loopback Management API with TLS server verification and Bearer from OS credential store; no shell/SFTP/agent forwarding.
management.userAuthorization: Core v1 has no human user or role database; an external management backend may authenticate users before calling Core. Core authenticates and audits only the authenticated client binding principal.
management.rawKey: Service-key plaintext is returned once; only verifier/metadata is persisted.
management.health: Unauthenticated health reveals process health only, not config or plugin inventory.

pluginWorkload.protocol: Plugin control uses the independent Plugin SDK REST API; pluginprotocol is only direct plugin-to-plugin communication and uses its independently configured authenticated transport.
pluginWorkload.replicaIdentity: Operator provisions a unique identity for every replica using an external CA/PEM or SPIFFE workload source and registers the expected identity with its fixed endpoint.
pluginWorkload.certificateAuthority: Core is not a workload CA; external CA/operator provisions remote identities and signed CRL bundles.
pluginWorkload.trustRoots: Management and plugin workload trust roots are distinct.
pluginWorkload.revocation: Invalid/missing/stale signed CRL fails closed; CRL update closes active channels; no insecure downgrade.
pluginWorkload.secretDelivery: Plugin settings pull carries opaque references only; secret bytes are delivered only through scoped Core REST grants.
pluginWorkload.interactionPolicy: Core distributes explicit caller-to-target/method/transport allow edges over Plugin SDK REST; default deny; direct peer calls are not proxied by Core.
pluginWorkload.recovery: Reconnect repeats identity/manifest/config/dispatch checks; unknown Call outcomes are not replayed and disconnected Streams are closed.

serverPlugin.configuration: Core JSON settings are the only desired-config source; plugin compiles/applies Caddy runtime configuration.
serverPlugin.persistentState: ACME certificates and site releases live in plugin-owned persistent local filesystem; the operator preserves this directory across manual restarts. One replica means no PostgreSQL/S3/shared-storage dependency.
serverPlugin.publicListeners: Opened by the plugin itself; Core does not run as root for Caddy and does not socket-activate public ports.

secrets.auditPayloads: No raw settings secrets, Caddy runtime payloads, credentials, cookies, private keys, grants or request bodies.
